highlights.title: Meta Refused to Share Muse for Testing, UK Financial Watchdog Complains
highlights.summary: The FCA warned against “another force of attack” from agents after the company declined a request to work on joint testing ahead of rolling out its personal agent in the UK on Tuesday.
body: Meta declined a suggestion from the UK’s financial regulator last week that they joint-test Muse using their sandbox, according to the watchdog’s head of innovation Colin Payne. It comes as regulators across the UK, including the competition and data watchdogs, warned Meta it needs to ensure its AI products comply with UK consumer protection laws.

“It’s another force of attack, agents hitting the streets, most of them coming from the US,” Payne, of the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), said Tuesday in a panel hosted by AI firm Whitespace. “We’ve got a number of entrants into the market. We want to see what they’re going to be doing in the market. I think it’s just reasonable,” he later explained to WIRED. Payne told WIRED the FCA had been hoping the organizations could work together to investigate what interactions might look like between the tool, marketed as a personal assistant, and a normal customer.
His organization has been experimenting with other firms as many, including Amazon, roll out AI shopping assistants, and other agentic tools in the UK.

highlights.title: GTA 6 Developers Have Voted Against Unionization by 75% to 25%
highlights.summary: Rockstar Games' UK workforce has voted firmly against unionization the week after the studio's latest game, Grand Theft Auto 6, demolished sales records.
body: The vote was 25% in favor of and 75% against a recognition agreement with the IWGB Game Workers Union. It's a decisive result, especially considering a 93.2% turnout for the vote, with 1,544 employees from Rockstar's offices in Edinburgh, Leeds, Lincoln, Dundee, and London participating.

The two-week ballot coincided not just with GTA 6 's launch, but with an employment tribunal hearing over the firing of 31 Rockstar workers in 2025. Rockstar argued the workers had leaked company secrets, while the IWGB characterized the action as union-busting. A judgment in the case is pending.

The union can continue to represent individual members, and Rockstar staff remain free to organize over pay, overtime, and other issues, but Rockstar management will not be formally required to meet or negotiate with union reps.
Rockstar Games head of publishing Jennifer Kolbe said in a statement that the company was "extraordinarily proud of our team, the culture we've built together and the launch of GTA 6."

highlights.title: Supercell shooter Boat Game is back in limited testing
highlights.summary: The Finnish firm’s lowkey shooter appears to be back on the App Store and Google Play in the US, Canada, Mexico, Malaysia and the Philippines.
body: Supercell appears to have revamped its looter shooter Boat Game and is now testing the title with a limited number of players.
The game was last seen back in October 2025, when Supercell ran a second alpha test. It was first revealed in February 2025, when selected players were part of a first alpha test.
When it first emerged Boat Game appeared to be more of a Sea of Thieves-like game, but the new edition is described as an extraction shooter on its app store listings.

A reported Discord message from Supercell’s community team reads: “The reception to the game last year was not what we hoped and we’ve spent this year thinking hard about what experience we want to give players and putting those ideas into the game.”

highlights.title: ‘Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping’ Devouring $85M Over Thanksgiving Weekend as ‘Focker-in-Law,’ ‘Hexed’ Launch
highlights.summary: Lionsgate's sixth film in its dystopian franchise looks to win its sophomore frame after notching franchise records with its debut Monday and Tuesday.
body: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping is claiming the head of the table at the Thanksgiving weekend box office as Focker-in-Law and Hexed enter the arena.

After opening to the fifth-biggest launch in Lionsgate history last weekend with $119 million domestically and $225 million worldwide, The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping has continued its momentum. The $150 million-budgeted film, which earned an A- CinemaScore, grossed $15.98 million domestically on Tuesday to notch the franchise’s biggest first Tuesday, narrowly topping the $15.96 million for 2013’s Catching Fire. Sunrise’ s Monday sum of $12.8 million also bested the series’ previous top opening Monday of $12.3 million for Catching Fire.

The East Coast has been impacted by a major storm stretching from the Midwest to the Eastern seaboard, leading the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade in New York to be moved to Saturday for the first postponement in its 100-year history. The inclement weather could slow down moviegoing throughout the weekend, including on Black Friday, which tends to be the biggest day for the box office over the Thanksgiving frame.

highlights.title: As Anthropic IPOs, Grand Theft Auto VI proves why efficiency isn’t a virtue
highlights.summary: On the same day that Anthropic entered the public market, a painstakingly human video game became one of most successful entertainment launches of all time.
body: It should have been impossible for “Grand Theft Auto VI” (GTA VI) to live up to the hype. Fans waited 13 years for the newest installment in the crime-adventure franchise, and Rockstar Games exceeded even those inconceivable expectations when the game finally came out last week.

GTA VI launched as the highest-rated game of all time on Metacritic and made $3.79 billion on release day to mark what could be the biggest entertainment event ever – more massive than “Avengers: Endgame” ( $2.9 billion ) or Taylor Swift’s Eras tour ( $2 billion ).
The 13-year wait certainly fueled the frenzy, and sales, around GTA VI, but some fans craved GTA VI because of what it represents in the emerging era of AI.

Even the biggest workaholics among us – startup founders – scheduled time off to play the game, including Spiry co-founder Dima Beseda, who told TechCrunch, “I reshuffled my workload to free up time around the weekends and even booked vitamin IV drips to keep my energy up.”

highlights.title: GB win decider to reach Davis Cup semis for first time since 2019
highlights.summary: Great Britain advance to the semi-finals of the Davis Cup for the first time since 2019 as Henry Patten and Neal Skupski win a decisive doubles tie against Germany in Bologna.
body: Great Britain advanced to the semi-finals of the Davis Cup for the first time since 2019 as Henry Patten and Neal Skupski won a decisive doubles tie against third seeds Germany in Bologna.
Patten and Skupski, playing together for the first time since announcing their doubles partnership for the 2027 season, proved too clinical for Kevin Krawietz and Tim Puetz.
They converted two break points and saved five in the first set, before overturning a mini-break in the tie-break to win 6-2 7-6 (8-6).

Skupski was involved in a Davis Cup quarter-final loss playing alongside Joe Salisbury against the same German doubles pair in December 2021 - a defeat that was in his mind as Thursday's decider progressed.

highlights.title: SFA to deliver revised proposal after young player vote delayed
highlights.summary: The Scottish FA will continue consulting with SPFL clubs in a bid to get more game time for homegrown talent after initial plans put forward by the governing body failed to reach a member vote.
body: Following an all-club meeting at St Andrews in September, the SFA proposed financial incentives - and penalties - along with quotas, in a bid to get more youngsters playing for clubs.
Initially, these proposals were to have been voted on at a SFA general meeting in October and the SPFL's annual meeting this month.
But the SFA now say they are aiming to put refreshed proposals to the clubs in the first quarter of 2027, in time for the start of the 2027-28 season.

Despite the governing body saying they are "encouraged", they add that "recent discussions have spawned a range of additional potential innovations that all parties agree will require further consultation."

highlights.title: 42 state AGs are trying to stop Character.AI from selling users’ chats
highlights.summary: A coalition of 42 state attorneys general is trying to prevent Character.AI from selling off user data as it navigates Chapter 11 bankruptcy proceedings. In a deluge of nearly identical press releases, the various AGs accuse the company of planning to auction off "the private chat histories of more…
body: A bipartisan coalition of AGs say Character.AI is planning to sell the personal data of minors to the highest bidder.

In October, Character.AI filed for bankruptcy following years of scandals and legal challenges, including from Disney. Disney ended up buying some of the company’s assets and hiring its CEO, Karandeep Anand, in a sort of “acquihire” arrangement that will also see “a number of Character.AI’s technical team” join the entertainment giant. The Disney deal also faced opposition from a similarly broad coalition of AGs.

The main point of contention with Character.AI’s plan to sell its chat data is that it offers no protections for users. The AGs say there are no requirements that the buyer honor existing privacy policies, no avenues for users to delete their data, and no inherent limits on what a buyer could do with that data, including selling it on to yet another party. It doesn’t help that the first bidder has a limited paper trail, having only been established on November 13th, 2026, with no parent company or investors listed.

highlights.title: BBC’s Antisemitism Crisis Represents an Unprecedented Chapter for the World’s Most Trusted News Organization
highlights.summary: It is a dark day for the BBC. On Thursday, government adviser Lord John Mann announced he is launching an investigation into alleged antisemitism at the broadcaster. It is an unprecedented chapter for the corporation, long held up as one of the most venerable and reliable media institutions in the…
body: Later, the broadcaster steadfastly refused to reprimand Gary Lineker, one of its most high-profile sports anchors, as he repeatedly breached its much-touted social media guidelines, which were instituted precisely because of Lineker’s increasingly political Twitter activity. Under the guidelines, high-profile presenters hosting flagship programs are expected to be impartial while the show is on air and for a two-week window before and after. At the time, he called the guidelines “very sensible.”

It was only when last year Lineker reposted an Instagram story about “Zionists” alongside a rat emoji that the BBC finally cut him loose. Even then, rather than a punitive measure, his exit was presented to the public as a mutually agreed decision for the host to leave after the final “Match of the Day” episode aired the following week. The BBC’s press release went on to call him a “defining voice in football coverage” and “thank him for the contribution he has made.”

highlights.title: Introducing the llama.cpp benchmark dashboard for AMD Ryzen and Radeon
highlights.summary: A Blog post by ggml-org on Hugging Face
body: The llama.cpp × AMD Benchmark dashboard is available on Hugging Face. It lets you track prompt processing and text generation performance across llama.cpp builds, models, and quantizations, so you can explore how local inference performs on AMD Ryzen and Radeon hardware.

Local inference performance changes as models, kernels, and builds evolve. We want those changes to be easy to inspect for any AMD developer: pick a hardware, a model and a build, compare quantizations, and follow performance over time. The benchmark workflow and underlying results are public, so you can also inspect how we benchmark inference performance.
You can choose Hardware, Model, and llama.cpp build in the Configuration sidebar. The current hardware choices are Radeon 8060S (gfx1151) and Radeon AI Pro R9700S (gfx1201).

Both tests start at context depth zero ( n_depth=0 ). PP512 measures processing 512 input tokens without generation; TG128 measures generating 128 tokens without a pre-existing context. The plotted value is the mean throughput ( avg_ts ). These are useful reference workloads, while the Context scaling tab lets you explore token generation throughput as the context grows.

highlights.title: Rockstar Games Has A GTA 6 Hit On Its Hands, But Its Union Vote Is A Loss
highlights.summary: Roughly 75% of Rockstar Games staff in the UK have voted against a formal recognition agreement with the Independent Workers' Union of Great Britain (IWGB). The news came in the wake of GTA 6 's record-breaking launch, and had the IWGB been recognized, Rockstar Games management would have been…
body: Voting took place across two weeks, and turnout was massive, with over 93% of UK staff casting their ballot (roughly 1,544 employees). The IWGB said it was undeterred by the result and would continue working to build support among Rockstar employees. "While the result means Rockstar will not be formally required to hold regular meetings with union representatives under a recognition agreement, it does not prevent workers from continuing to organize and push for workplace improvements through the IWGB, joining the union or exercising their individual trade union rights and protections," the union said in a statement.

The vote also comes hot on the heels of the IWGB taking Rockstar to an employment tribunal, alleging unlawful dismissal and union busting after it fired over 30 employees last year for gross misconduct over alleged leaks of confidential information. Closing submissions were wrapped up shortly before the vote results came out, and a ruling is still pending. While game dev unionizing has gained significant momentum over the years, a decisive loss at one of the industry's biggest studios could be a notable speed bump for union organizers.

highlights.title: Google’s patent for custom AI video feeds paints a bleak picture of entertainment’s future
highlights.summary: Last year, Google filed a patent for a system called My Channel that's designed to create feeds filled with personalized, AI-generated videos and advertisements based on information the company knows about its users.
body: Imagine an endless feed of AI slop in which you are the main character of every story.

First spotted by Patentlyze, the patent — which was filed last May and published last week — describes how My Channel would use a person’s demographic data and viewing history to create its own prompts that would then be fed into an LLM to help generate AI videos tailored to that person’s specific interests. In addition to factoring in what kinds of videos a user tends to watch, the system would capture contextual data from their device like IP addresses, GPS locations, and specific details about the user’s age. My Channel could also base its prompts on current news like sports scores and things happening on social media, and all of the video generation would take place on Google’s servers.

highlights.title: Microsoft-Owned GitHub Stuns Followers as It Celebrates AnyPS5 Repo in Now-Deleted Tweet
highlights.summary: In a post that’s since been deleted, Microsoft-owned code and software collaboration site GitHub celebrated the AnyPS5 repo “passing 58k stars” from users on the platform as a result of the launch of GTA 6.
body: “GTA 6 is finally here, sparking one of the biggest weeks in gaming and open source on GitHub,” the post said, before jumping into celebrating the repo. “Does changing where games run cross a legal line?” the tweet asked.

There was also an official video attached to the tweet, which highlighted a post from an AnyPS5 coder, via Kotaku. The post in the video said: “We have 3 days until GTA 6 everyone get your agents or deevs[sic] and work.”

While the post could easily be the work of a rogue social media person, the optics aren’t good at all. GTA 6 is only officially available on PS5 and Xbox Series X and S, so both Sony and Microsoft have benefited greatly from the game's record-breaking launch. To see a the Microsoft-owned GitHub post a message to its followers essentially encouraging potential piracy is remarkable.
IGN has asked for comment, but GitHub obviously realized its mistake — it deleted the tweet, after all — but how it even got approved in the first place is a mystery until the company comments.

body: Quentin Tarantino ’s Once Upon a Time in Hollywood is rich in striking, darkly memorable imagery: Margot Robbie shimmying in a sunshine-yellow two-piece at the Playboy Mansion; the sunbaked menace of Brad Pitt’s visit to the Manson ranch; the audaciously bloody denouement, all pit bulls and flamethrowers, playing out high in the Hollywood Hills, with the glittering carpet of nighttime Los Angeles extending endlessly beyond.

But for some—this writer included—the film’s most indelible legacy is its costumes. And, more specifically, those of Pitt’s laid-back (and possibly wife-murdering) stuntman Cliff Booth. Double-denim layers, gold-rimmed aviators, scuffed moccasins—and, of course, those Hawaiian shirts—the character’s late-’60s California cool burnt up the screen and almost certainly played a part in the Americana wave that plenty of menswear fanatics are still riding.

highlights.title: FCC signs off on SpaceX’s plan to put up to 1 million data center satellites into space
highlights.summary: In an announcement on Wednesday, the FCC says it authorized SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million AI chip-equipped satellites as part of the Elon Musk-owned company's "Starmind" initiative.
body: SpaceX aims to power AI capabilities here on Earth with its ‘Starmind’ constellation.

The FCC’s approval requires SpaceX to deploy at least one satellite by 2033, and meet the 1 million satellite milestone by 2040. The FCC also deferred SpaceX’s request to dispose of satellites located above 600km in space “graveyard” orbits, rather than having them burn up in the Earth’s atmosphere, saying the company hasn’t provided “sufficient information” about its disposal process plans.

SpaceX has described its Starmind project as a way to “capture solar energy in space to power” AI capabilities on Earth. The company says Starmind will transmit data to Earth using high-speed lasers that connect to Starlink. It plans to produce chips for its satellites at an upcoming Terafab facility.

Google has already taken its first steps toward putting compute into space, with the launch of a “Project Suncatcher” AI server satellite last month. Jeff Bezos’ Blue Origin will carry out the first dedicated heavy-lift launch for Project Suncatcher in 2029.

body: After colliding on track in final practice last weekend, Russell publicly criticised Verstappen following the incident. The Dutchman won the race after an intense battle between them and said afterwards that the Mercedes driver is "far below my level".

The pair have clashed several times on track in the past, most notably engaging in a remarkable war of words following an incident during qualifying at the 2024 Qatar Grand Prix where Verstappen felt Russell had pushed unreasonably hard for him to be penalised.

Speaking on Thursday - back at the Lusail International Circuit almost exactly two years on from that incident - ahead of this weekend's Qatar Grand Prix, Russell said: "At the end of the day, I guess I stand by what I said after practice.

"But he was the one who went out and won the race. I didn't and I'm sure he had a bit of a laugh about that, and that was reasonably amusing. From my side, just a new race weekend, try and focus on the driving and move on."

videos.title: SPURS at TRAIL BLAZERS | EMIRATES NBA CUP 🏆 | FULL GAME HIGHLIGHTS | November 25, 2026
videos.summary: The Trail Blazers defeated the Spurs, 116-111 tonight in Portland. Deni Avdija finished with a team-high 33 points along with 12 rebounds and 7 assists for the Trail Blazers, while Damian Lillard tallied 29 points, 7 assists and 5 three pointers in the game.
body: Never miss a moment with the latest news, trending stories and highlights to bring you closer to your favorite players and teams.
points: The Trail Blazers defeated the Spurs, 116-111 tonight in Portland.
Deni Avdija finished with a team-high 33 points along with 12 rebounds and 7 assists for the Trail Blazers, while Damian Lillard tallied 29 points, 7 assists and 5 three pointers in the game.
Victor Wembanyama recorded 44 points, 16 rebounds and 3 assists.
The Trail Blazers improve their record to 12-6 with the win, while the Spurs fall to 15-4 for the season.
